title: Mel Gets Roasted! Who Went Home on 'The Golden Bachelor' Tonight? - NewsBreak
text:
By Andrea Reiher ,
1 hours ago
The Golden Bachelor wasted no time jumping right in on the way Nicolle was all over Mel Owens during last week's premiere. It is really rankling some of the women, especially Cindy, who has been cheated on in the past and admits that that is what makes this so hard for her.
Nicolle tells the ladies that she got caught up in the moment, but it doesn't seem like that is going to change her behavior at all. She seems very unbothered that the other ladies don't love how she's been monopolizing Mel's time (and mouth). We shall see how this plays out in future episodes, since the show doesn't really revisit Nicolle and the other ladies' dynamic after the opening segment.
RELATED: Meet the Two Biggest Cheerleaders in ‘Golden Bachelor’ Mel Owens’ Life
The Group Date Nicolle, Gerri, Robin, Amy, Monica B., Cindy, Terri, Cheryl, Carol, Monica P., Peg and Roxanne, which means Debbie was getting the one-on-one date.
The group date consisted of going to Los Angeles' historic Bellwether Theater, where comedian Jared Freid coached the ladies through a roast of Mel. The roast went well. I particularly liked Cheryl's joke about Detroit-style pizza being like Mel, "crusty, cheesy and square." Monica B. also did a great job.
Nicolle "won" the solo dinner, though honestly, her roast material wasn't that great. Mel just obviously wanted to have some alone time with her. What we saw of the dinner consisted of them talking about the end of Mel's marriage . Nothing earth-shattering. And then Nicolle got the rose, so she was safe this week.
RELATED: ‘Golden Bachelor’ Shocker: What Mel Owens’ Ex-Wife Said About His Reality TV Debut
The One-on-One Date Mel took Debbie to a fancy restaurant where Chef Ludo Lefebvre gave them a cooking demonstration of a French omelet, which is a classic test for a chef, and then Chef Ludo made them dinner. That's my kind of date. It seemed to go really well, and Debbie got a rose.
Meanwhile, back at the ranch, Kathy Swarts and Susan Noles from season 1 paid a visit to the new cast members. That was a lot of fun, though there was a little pearl-clutching during "Never Have I Ever," which was eyeroll-inducing. Who even cares? Live your best life, Gerri!
Susan and Kathy also brought pink vibrators for everyone, and Peg wasn't sure what it was. Oh, Peg. You are too adorable.
RELATED: ‘Golden Bachelor’s’ Father Was a Negro Leagues Hall of Famer
Who Went Home During the Rose Ceremony on The Golden Bachelor Season 2, Episode 2? Prior to the third Rose Ceremony, there was a cocktail hour and Carol had the most awkward interaction with Mel ever because she's very nervous to kiss him. Aw, Carol. You gotta relax, girlfriend.
At the Rose Ceremony, Nicolle and Debbie already had roses, and the remaining seven roses went to Cindy, Peg, Roxanne, Gerri, Cheryl, Robin, and Carol, which means the four women eliminated this week were:

Amy
Short Hills, New Jersey
Full-Time Mom, 63 Monica B.
Huntsville, Alabama
Flight Attendant, 62 Monica P.
Birmingham, Alabama
Cosmetic Dentist, 60 Terri
Houston, Texas
Cosmetic Dentist, 71 The women were all full of tears, saying goodbye to their new friends, and Terri seemed particularly bummed to be eliminated. They have to get Amy for Bachelor in Paradise , that woman is a hoot. And next week, we get our first "here for the wrong reasons" conversation. Can't wait!
